evidence.snippet: Using OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps.
As an admin, you can easily generate and revoke your access token in the settings of your account.
Explore our guides and technical documentation to integrate with Gorgias.

The Gorgias Model Context Protocol (MCP) app allows your third-party AI assistant to access your Gorgias data and account, so it can read and analyze your helpdesk tickets, and audit and update your Gorgias settings.
We'll review it and let you know once it's approved and ready to be published in our App Store.
